text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I 
noticed Tani no Gimlet lingering in a 
deserted classroom. When I called out to 
ask what was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nothing comes to mind... Not even the 
"tragic farewell" I yearned so deeply to 
write!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The narrative goes thus... A solitary 
researcher who had repeated farewells time 
and again—he had grown utterly weary.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No more farewells were needed. Thinking 
thus, he created an immortal partner to 
keep by his side.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However! Upon him who rejected farewells, 
alas! An unforeseen tragic parting 
befalls!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Beyond that, I cannot write! The 
paramount scene I ought to desire most! 
The supreme moment that intoxicates the 
masses...!
choice_data_list:
Why not consult a horse girl who knows 
stories well?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kh, for this scene alone I wished to forge 
the answer from within... but it seems 
there is no other way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, a truly fascinating tale. A tragedy 
steeped in irony, yet the failure of its 
birth is another tragedy in itself...!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Lend me your wisdom, King of the Opera, 
and Custodian of Tomes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, judging from what 
you've described, the theme and concept 
are already firmly established...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha! In my view, it feels as though 
"someone" is blocking the fountain of your 
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just who on earth could it be?! What is 
the name of the fence obstructing my 
path?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something she should normally produce 
isn't coming out... Speaking of recent 
changes with her...
choice_data_list:
...Could it be, say, "the audience you 
must reach"?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Absurd! How could the audience, the 
very subjects to be intoxicated, drag me 
down—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's not impossible. When writing a 
script, there are so many things to 
consider, like technique and how to convey 
ideas clearly...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
While paying too much attention to those, 
what you originally wanted to do might 
have become obscured.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So why not recall what you initially 
wished to write?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your origin. Simply put, what was it? What 
were your thoughts when you began crafting 
this script?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Write that which you wish to write!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to write... tragedy. It was my 
aesthetic... something embodying an 
unavoidable farewell as I conceived it—

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet I pondered... Will this truly reach 
them? Will the audience be intoxicated? 
Then, to make it go down smoother, 
meticulously, so meticulously—

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I diluted it.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Nay. I was meant to scorch their 
throats! With the farewell I envision! 
With a tragic, cruel fate that descends 
without mercy!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh... Ohhh...! Indeed, that was it... I 
remember now...! Why did I hold back... In 
that case, in that case...!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The scientist is confronted with the 
truth! That farewell is inevitable! Left 
with no choice but to gaze upon the 
departing back leaving their two-person 
world!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Scorched by hellfire as retribution for 
touching the taboo... bidding farewell 
alone... knowing eternity exists 
nowhere...!!!!
choice_data_list: ...Looks like she's going to be fine now!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...How is it, my script this time? After 
scribbling it down in a flurry of impulse, 
I believe I formatted it into proper 
theatrical form.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it's definitely a solid script. 
But it's razor-sharp and certainly chooses 
its audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, scripts that 
uncompromisingly stick to what they want 
to convey have a place too.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Thus, my tragedy was completed. It 
stirred quiet intrigue in various circles, 
sparking swirling debates of theories and 
impressions.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just as intended... nay, leaving behind a 
luscious aftertaste beyond even my 
calculations.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is scriptwriting! This is the 
stage! As the prelude to my aesthetics and 
intoxication... look forward to the day 
this curtain rises once again!!
